ideas.title: Compartmental dopamine (several modulator channels)
ideas.evidence: random colours: global 2.61 vs compartments 1.76 vs mushroom-body preset 0.47 (80 gens, 3 seeds)
ideas.why: no gain; reversal unsolved by all variants

ideas.title: Developmental (grown) genome instead of direct weights
ideas.evidence: direct 11.23 vs developmental 3.86 at 80 gens, but genome 890 vs 143 numbers and constant (~140-210) from 30 to 420 hidden cells; hand recipe reaches ~11
ideas.why: compact, scales; the project's founding principle; later hand plans + evolution close the gap

ideas.title: Robust fitness over several regrowths (K growths, mean - lambda*sd, worstW)
ideas.evidence: single-growth champions 4.78 own seed but 2.71 regrown; robust 3.13 vs 3.17 (no lucky-growth gap), better worst case 2.07 vs 1.17
ideas.why: removes the lucky-growth bias; held-out growths are now the standard check

ideas.title: Trophic competition / activity refinement / homeostasis during growth
ideas.evidence: ablations within noise on bug task (3.17 all vs 3.42-3.88); only homeostasis protects the worst case (min 2.07 vs 1.33)
ideas.why: kept as plausible defaults; homeostasis buffers developmental noise

ideas.title: Crossed two-latch working memory (plan memory)
ideas.evidence: 41-48% failed growths: loop gain varies; mirror 65%, grow-until-satisfied 47%
ideas.why: needs fine asymmetry that growth noise destroys; replaced by memoryK

ideas.title: memoryK: slow self-exciting columns with topographic snapping
ideas.evidence: K-way recall, curriculum reached delay 200 (40x cue); knockouts -> 0
ideas.why: robust generic working memory; default for same-mapping cue/recall

ideas.title: Synaptic scaling, topo maps, parallel fibres, grow-until-satisfied, redundancy genes
ideas.evidence: enable memoryK and the predict plans; old genomes bit-identical
ideas.why: generic mechanisms reused by every later plan

ideas.title: Hunger / deprivation signal and activity-timed requests (Travis)
ideas.evidence: orphan outputs / silent inputs to 0% on recall4 (hunger_test); later split: hunger mixed deficit with waiting time
ideas.why: superseded by separate local connection demand (R28)

ideas.title: Teacher-gated plasticity (climbing-fibre-like plateau) for prediction
ideas.evidence: predictK learns bigram-like text 0.49 last q (83% of ideal counter); cycle K=16 1.00
ideas.why: local, works within one lifetime

ideas.title: Second-order context via M2 shift register (predictK2*)
ideas.why: each step a replicated gain

ideas.why: pure speed

ideas.title: Bigger tissue (80x80) for more conjunctive cells

ideas.title: Metaplasticity + learned trust (metaN, trustPow)

ideas.title: Divisive normalisation of the prediction layer + graded decoder
ideas.evidence: 0.650 -> 0.673 (0.686 graded); shared inhibitory pool rejected (fights teacher)

ideas.title: Mixing (granule / Kenyon-like) layer with intrinsic homeostatic thresholds
ideas.evidence: predictK2XG 0.720 vs XS 0.673 vs XM 0.694 (32 growths); competitive instar learning neutral/harmful

ideas.title: Actor-critic: outcome RPE critic, value-dependent noise, efference loop (rewardK / rewardMemK)
ideas.evidence: bandit best arm 0.653 (Thompson 0.692); cue random last q 0.883; each part ablated hurts; TD critic fails

ideas.title: Context cascade predictK3 (second region holding the symbol two back)
ideas.why: first multi-region win

ideas.title: Two-region actor-critic (cortex -> striatum, rewardKR)
ideas.why: below single tissue; later unified genome solved the goal differently

ideas.title: One learning rule for teacher and reward tasks (uni: dw = lr*M*e)
ideas.evidence: order3 0.970/0.968, text 0.773/0.769, bandit 0.653/0.653, cue 0.855/0.855; dopamine on instructed cells rejected (collapse, 20x slower)

ideas.title: Headless runner (bun, worker pool) + dashboard
ideas.evidence: multi-hour runs on PC and box; live current.js
ideas.why: infrastructure

ideas.title: Balanced multitask fitness (weakest task counts most)
ideas.evidence: overnight champion 1.18 -> 0.49 under the new score; balanced run 0.47 -> 0.62
ideas.why: stops trading one task away

ideas.title: Evolved reward plan rewardE (whole genome kept)
ideas.evidence: bandit 6.80 vs 5.28, cue random 9.68 vs 4.79, recall random 1.37 vs -3.25; no single gene explains it
ideas.why: default reward genome until R35

ideas.title: Local connection demand (target-derived attractant, off when satisfied)
ideas.evidence: 2x outputs: coverage 72% -> 94%, 0 orphans, no task worse
ideas.why: separates demand from the other 4 signals

ideas.title: Need-driven growth (adult neurogenesis on persistent errors)
ideas.evidence: half-size text brain: wins back ~1/4 of the lost accuracy; never triggers on reward tasks; PC evolution 0.59 vs 0.62
ideas.why: new cells get random claws (worse than structured mixing inputs); reward areas stop being surprised. Known fixes: (1) give recruits the same structured (topo/claw) inputs as grown mixing cells; (2) drive reward areas by raw failure rate, not RPE surprise

ideas.title: One genome, areas from the task I/O (unifiedR, receptor genes for clock A and outcome O)
ideas.evidence: bit-identical to predictK3/rewardE on single-signal tasks; evolved champion 1.017 within noise
ideas.why: one genome decides; v30 default

ideas.title: Graded areas (size follows expression) and linear corticostriatal tracts (unifiedG)
ideas.evidence: seqchoice random 3.09 vs rewardE 3.80
ideas.why: linear context gives no conjunctions

ideas.title: Conjunctive corticostriatal input from mixing cells (unifiedC)
ideas.evidence: 3.57 alone (R32); as part of v32 unifiedR seqchoice order2 5.20 vs rewardE2 4.52
ideas.why: used inside v32 with a full striatum

ideas.title: Reward learner on 6x6 pairings: short trace / tag consumption / receiver homeostasis
ideas.evidence: cycle 4.54 -> 8.74 with tauElig 8 + rcvHomeo 0.3, but bandit 3.53, cue 1.74; eligUse 0.7 neutral
ideas.why: trial-matched trace helps short trials, breaks long-delay tasks

ideas.title: Dual-timescale eligibility (fast + slow tags, evolvable mix) -> rewardE2
ideas.why: no loss, clear gain on pairings

ideas.title: Timing-gated trace selection (synapse recency or outcome interval)
ideas.evidence: gate2 T=30 cycle 8.65 but bandit 5.79; T=10 6.84/10.26/6.96 within noise
ideas.why: outcome timing does not separate the tasks

ideas.title: Outcome -> full striatum owns outputs, clock -> graded cortex feeding it (v32)
ideas.evidence: seqchoice cycle 6.78 (was 1.45), order2 5.20 (was 1.41); text/order3/bandit/cue bit-identical
ideas.why: one genome now covers mixed tasks

ideas.title: Longer context for text (beyond 3 symbols)
ideas.evidence: fables stuck at ~0.32; order3 solved only by explicit shift register
ideas.why: text track (issue #2)

ideas.title: Typed-array / WebGPU neuron update
ideas.evidence: rewardE/unifiedR gens ~6 min on PC
ideas.why: text track (issue #3)

ideas.evidence: none yet
ideas.why: text track (issue #1)

ideas.title: Patterned vs random activity shaping growth
ideas.evidence: not run

ideas.title: Striatum evolved on bandit 3/6 arms + seqchoice (q04 champion) transplanted into unifiedR = rewardE3
ideas.evidence: whole champion: text 0.40, order3 1.37 (collapse); striatum only: bandit6 5.11 vs 4.31 (+0.81 ± 0.31), cycle 7.24 vs 6.78, cue -0.08 ± 0.46 (40 growths), text/order3 bit-identical

ideas.title: Re-evolved dual-trace genes (q09, 2 h)
ideas.evidence: champion 1.00: cycle 7.25, bandit 6.47, cue 10.67 (refs 6.86/11.31)
ideas.why: no gain beyond rewardE2

ideas.title: Five-task evolution from v32 (q01, 3 h, 19 gens)
ideas.evidence: champion 0.966 never beat the start; text generations ~18 min
ideas.why: text makes generations slow; mutants lose text first

ideas.title: Lifetime length is the biggest lever for sequence choice
ideas.evidence: seqchoice 1000 symbols: cycle 8.94, order2 5.85 vs 6.78 / 5.20 at 300 (q11); rewardE2 order2@1000 4.71 (q17); R45 life curve (q25, unifiedR v33, 16 growths): seqchoice cycle 150/600/2000 symbols 5.82/8.48/9.20, order2 4.76/5.55/6.08 (still rising at 2000)
ideas.why: the reward area learns slowly; long lives, or better sample efficiency, are what pay

ideas.title: Juvenile waves are essential but their pattern is not (yet)
ideas.evidence: q05: shuffled = patterned; no waves collapses cue to 3.37; regions skip juvenile (q05b identical)
ideas.why: activity drives maturation; structure of activity untested on task-shaped input -> q21 (juvMode 3 vs 4)

ideas.title: eligUse gene
ideas.evidence: q10: no gain beyond noise
ideas.why: ruled out

ideas.title: Six-task evolution from v33 (q16)
ideas.evidence: champion 1.018 = the start genome (gen 0); no mutant improved
ideas.why: text-bearing multitask evolution too slow to search

ideas.title: Structured recruits (ngStruct) and failure-rate need (ngFail)
ideas.evidence: implemented R40; smoke runs ok (ngFail changes cycle 3.69->3.66 at 2 growths) | shared queue (Oct 16-17): q22 predictK3 ng+ngReduce 0.5: text 6.56 vs base 7.26, order3 7.54 vs 8.53 (ngStruct worse: 6.35 / 7.45); q23 ngFail: no recovery (cueR -1.24 in all arms); q24 ngFail evolve 3 h: champion 1.017 < 1.03 (bandit 0.89 of ref)
ideas.why: q02/q03 were blocked on these; now q22, q23, q24

ideas.title: Task-shaped juvenile activity (juvMode 3) vs same pulses shuffled (4)
ideas.evidence: q21 (rewardE3, 16 growths) juvMode 3 (task-shaped) vs 4 (same pulses shuffled): bandit 6.67/6.69, cueR 9.88/9.25, cycle 7.33/7.04, order2@300 5.12/5.09 (base 6.78/9.25/7.44/5.00); hold 8: cueR 8.62. All within noise (sd 0.6-2.3)
ideas.why: I42 left open whether the pattern matters when it resembles the task

ideas.title: World model: taught cells predict their next input; mismatch (spike without teacher plateau) depresses inputs (pl.predErr)
ideas.evidence: q27 (16 held-out growths, means; unpaired t): predictK3 order3 8.53 -> 8.82 (0.05, t~1.7) / 8.75 (0.15) / 8.16 (0.3); text 7.26 -> 7.21 / 7.13 / 6.98 (dose-dependent loss, t -0.9/-1.8/-3.3); unifiedR seqchoice order2@1000 5.85 -> 5.74 (0.1) / 4.41 (0.3). Not adopted. Hint on order3 only at small rates -> q29 retests 0.02/0.05 on the v34 deep plan with 32 paired growths | R50 q29 (deepURSx3, 32 paired growths, base -> 0.02 / 0.05): text3000 7.79 -> 7.86 / 8.10 (t 2.8 / 11.8), order3 9.00 -> 9.25 / 9.35 (t 3.5 / 4.6), text1000 7.37 -> 7.36 / 7.49 (t -0.3 / 4.3), but fables2000 2.94 -> 2.77 / 2.31 (t -5.9 / -18.2, 0/32 wins at 0.05; accuracy already lower in the first quarter 0.221 -> 0.160). Not adoptable (fables). Gains still rising at 0.05 -> q35 doses 0.1/0.2; q36 with depth; I64 gate for the fables loss; held-out p01/p03, fables dose p04 on the shared queue | R52/R53: soft-bound and hybrid rules (pl.peMode 1 / 16, pl.peFix) remove the fables loss; hybrid predErr 0.3, peMode 16, peFix 0.01 on deepURSx3, 32 paired held-out growths: fables -0.007 (t -0.7), text3000 +0.164 (t 11.7), order3 +0.085 (t 2.5), text1000 +0.086 (t 6.6), order2@1000 +0.23 (t 1.2), text5000 +0.236 (t 8.1, n 16). ADOPTED v35 (DEFAULTS_VERSION 28) after Travis's approval (Oct 17)
ideas.why: step 1 of the world-model roadmap; local error-driven rule, no backprop

ideas.title: Slow context layers: chain of increasingly slow recurrent/adaptive cells summarising the layer below
ideas.evidence: R43: slow-membrane modules (mixLeak by position) neutral at x2, harmful at x4; depth as a chained shift register (deepK3, I54) works instead; R52: slow context region (symbol-driven, slowLeak 0.98, wIn 2, claw -> mixing; plan slowS98w2) 32 paired growths: text3000 +0.11/+0.14 (t 5.0/6.7), text1000 +0.09/+0.10, order3 0, fables -0.03/-0.04 (t -1.9/-2.5); slower (0.995) or stronger (wIn 4) layers wreck order3 (-1.73)
ideas.why: gives 'where it came from' state for long non-repeating sequences

ideas.title: Alphabet-transfer analogy test: learn a grammar on one alphabet, relabel symbols, measure relearning speed vs fresh brain
ideas.evidence: R45: seq env option relabel (rename all symbols by one random permutation from that fraction of the life on; stats q1/q2); box smoke 2 growths deepURSx3: order3 n2000 fresh first quarter 0.91 vs 0.62 right after the renaming (no-relabel 1.00) -> interference, not yet transfer; q31 measures 16 growths, q33 evolves for it | R50 q31 (16 growths): no transfer, interference. Post-switch quarter q2 vs a fresh brain's first quarter: order3 0.594 vs 0.917 (deepURSx3), 0.589 vs 0.874 (unifiedR); cycle 0.617 vs 0.954; text 0.436 vs 0.616. predErr 0.05 speeds unlearning: order3 q2 0.718, cycle 0.807, text 0.453 (still below fresh). Next: q37 (predErr 0.1/0.2 after renaming), q33 evolve, p02/p05 held-out on the shared queue; real analogy probably needs role/structure cells that are not tied to symbol identity (I63)
ideas.why: faster relearning = reusable role/structure circuits (analogy)

ideas.title: Imagined rollouts: feed the world model's predictions back as input to try actions before taking them (bug world)
ideas.why: needs I47 accurate first

ideas.title: Bottom-up stage 1: word-boundary chunker (env chunk: 2 outputs boundary / in-word, spaces as free dopamine labels; seq stats bF1)
ideas.evidence: R42, 16 held-out growths, 1000 chars: dedicated chunker F1 rewardE 0.485, unifiedR 0.434, rewardE3 0.432, predictK3 0.136 vs online letter-bigram 0.725. But the next-character predictor (predictK3 on text) already marks boundaries at F1 0.868 (P 0.856 R 0.881) vs bigram 0.733: chunking emerges from prediction for free
ideas.why: stage 1 of bottom-up staging; result: use the predictive cortex itself as the chunker, not a reward-trained boundary region

ideas.title: Fractal module tiling: predictK3 module x M (tiledK3xM), extra modules mixing cells -> module 0 receivers
ideas.evidence: R42, 16 growths: text 7.264 (x1) / 7.368 (x2) / 7.360 (x4) / 7.174 (x8); order3 8.529 / 8.333 / 7.215 / 7.228 (x4+ collapses to the order-2 limit, last quarter 0.90 -> 0.74). Inter-module weight irrelevant when plastic (preNorm rescales each fibre cell to 45); fixed weights 10/45 same collapse
ideas.why: convergence of copies onto one output module dilutes the module own third-order context; needs I53/I54

ideas.title: Module voting: every tiled module owns a copy of the outputs; outputs sum (population vote) instead of feeding module 0 receivers
ideas.evidence: R43 voteK3x2 / x4: text +0.10 / +0.09 (t 5.0 / 3.5, replicate +0.09) but order3 -0.25 / -0.87 (redundant votes from modules wash out the third-order output). Cheap text gain only; deepK3 beats it on both
ideas.why: R42: naive convergence hurt order3; parallel columns voting at the readout is how cortex pools redundant columns

ideas.title: Specialized modules by morphogen position: module k context depth k+2 (longer shift registers / slower clocks) so copies add NEW information (longer memory) instead of redundant
ideas.evidence: R43, 32 held-out growths (16 + fresh 16 replicate): deepK3x2 (one extra chained context = symbol 3 back -> mixing) order3 8.529->8.931 / replicate 8.584->9.019 (paired t 3.2 / 4.4, last quarter 0.94), text +0.07 (t 1.9 / 3.0); deepK3x4 text +0.13 / +0.14 (t 4.8 both, last quarter 0.786), order3 +0.09 / +0.26. Slower-membrane modules (slowK3x2/x4, mixLeak 0.8-0.95): x2 neutral, x4 harmful (text -0.20, order3 -1.16). Deeper memory helps; slower membranes do not. Candidate default (deepK3x2 or x3) pending a fables / mixed-task check
ideas.why: R42: identical copies carry the same third-order code; scaling must add memory depth (ties to I48 slow context layers, issue #2)

ideas.title: Stage 2: word-level region fed by the cortex boundary/prediction signal (word onset gating a slow word-context register) for next-letter and next-word prediction
ideas.evidence: R43 wordK3: slow word region (context program, memory columns accumulate letters, inhibited by the cortex own next_space prediction, claw -> mixing): text 7.210 vs 7.264 (-0.05, t -3.1), boundary F1 0.859 vs 0.867; no-reset control 7.097 (reset helps the region, -0.17 -> -0.05) but a bag-of-letters word state still hurts; claw weight 10 vs 30 identical (mixNorm). Next: word state as a sequence code (I56)
ideas.why: R42 showed boundaries are already available from prediction (F1 0.87); stage 2 should consume them, not retrain them

ideas.title: deepK3 follow-ups: x3 depth, fables + mixed task held-out check, then adopt as text default if it holds
ideas.evidence: R44, 32 held-out growths: depth x2/x3/x4 text +0.07/+0.10/+0.14 (t 3.3/4.7/6.8), order3 +0.42/+0.44/+0.17, fables +0.02 n.s.; extra context areas in unifiedR hurt seqchoice cycle -0.75/-1.52/-2.25 and order2 (x3 -0.43); outcome-repressed areas (deepURSx3) identical to unifiedR on mixed tasks. Candidate default deepURSx3 pending approval. ADOPTED v34 (DEFAULTS_VERSION 27) after approval
ideas.why: R43 deepK3 is the first scaling that helps (order3 +0.4, text +0.13)

ideas.title: Word region as an ordered code (position-in-word x letter conjunctions) rather than a bag of letters, still reset by the predicted space
ideas.evidence: R44 wordChainx3/x4 (deep chain reset by predicted space = ordered in-word memory): text +0.01/-0.00, fables -0.00/-0.01 vs unreset chain +0.10/+0.14; cross-word context is what depth buys
ideas.why: R43: bag-of-letters word state hurt; order inside the word is what carries information

ideas.title: Memory depth x life length: deeper chains (deepURSx6/x8) pay off only with long lives (text 3000/5000, fables 5000) and bigger alphabets (order3 K12/16)
ideas.evidence: R44: depth gain grows x2->x4 on text 1000 (+0.07/+0.10/+0.14) but fables 2000 only +0.02; box smoke 1 growth: x6/x8 text 1000 7.38/7.42 vs x3 7.34. q28, q32 (16 growths, paired with R44 seeds) | R50 q28/q32 (16 paired growths vs deepURSx3): text gains grow with depth and life: text5000 x4/x6/x8 +0.05/+0.15/+0.21 (t 1.6/4.3/6.4, x8 15/16 wins), text3000 +0.03/+0.12/+0.17 (t 0.9/3.8/5.1), text1000 x6/x8 +0.05/+0.11 (t 1.2/2.6); but fables loses: fables5000 x6/x8 -0.03/-0.06 (t -2.9/-4.1), fables2000 x8 -0.09 (t -6.3); order3 x6/x8 -0.08/-0.26 (n.s.). order3 K12/K16 is at ceiling for every plan (9.81-9.89, last quarter 1.0) -> uninformative. Depth is a text-only win; not adoptable as a default. Held-out p06/p07 on the shared queue; q36 tests depth + predErr | shared p06/p07 (g16-31): x6 text3000 +0.165, x8 +0.24 vs x3 (replicates). R54 caveat: the "text" corpus is a 224-character loop, so text3000/5000 replay it 13-22 times; long-life text gains measure loop recall. fables (4270 chars) is the only non-repeating long test, where depth loses
ideas.why: I41 life length is the biggest lever; Travis: longer memory for non-repetitive sequence prediction; fractal scaling that adds new memory depth (I54)

ideas.title: Evolve the v34 deep plan on long-memory prediction (text/fables 2000 + order3; and text/fables 5000 from deepURSx4)
ideas.evidence: queued q30 (5 h) and q34 (3 h); earlier multitask evolutions mostly returned the start genome (I40, I44, q19 0.945, q26 1.019) | R50: q30 interrupted 3:05-6:30 PM Oct 16 (PC lost power), resumed from its gen-2 checkpoint; after 3 gens (2.4 h active) champion 1.0025 = start genome
ideas.why: sequence-only fitness is cheaper per generation than text+reward multitask and targets the key focus

ideas.title: Sample efficiency at 300-symbol lives by rate genes (lr, rpeLr, metaN) or evolution (q20, q26)
ideas.evidence: q20 rewardE3 16 growths: lr x1.5/x2/x3 cycle 7.43/7.28/6.87 vs 7.44, cueR 9.71/10.37/9.60 vs 9.25 (n.s.), bandit 6.85/6.70/6.39 vs 6.78; rpeLr 0.5/0.8 cycle 7.77/7.38; metaN 20/40 bit-identical (unused by rewardE3). q26 evolve 3 h (105 gens): champion 1.019 < 1.03, cycle@300 8.02 vs 7.05 (+14%) but order2 4.67 vs 4.91 (-5%). q19 1000-symbol multitask evolve 0.945
ideas.why: Q19: short lives far below long-life scores (I41)

ideas.title: predErr dose above 0.05 on the deep plan (0.1 / 0.2): find the peak for text / order3
ideas.evidence: R50: q29 gains rise from 0.02 to 0.05 on text3000 (+0.07 -> +0.31), order3 (+0.25 -> +0.35), text1000 (-0.01 -> +0.12); q27 on predictK3 lost text at 0.15/0.3, so the deep plan may tolerate more. Queued q35 | R54: not run on the PC (q35 retired): the additive rule's fables loss scales with dose (shared p04: 0.01 -> 2.885 = base, 0.03 -> 2.503, 0.05 -> -0.63), and R53's hybrid rule (v35) removed it; the v35 dose neighbourhood is q43 + shared s07/s08
ideas.why: largest single gain on long text since R44; Travis's world-model / prediction-mismatch focus

ideas.title: Depth x world model: deeper chains (x6/x8) + predErr; does mismatch depression prune the noisy extra context that costs order3 / fables?
ideas.evidence: R50: depth and predErr both gain on long text (x8 text5000 +0.21, predErr 0.05 text3000 +0.31) and both lose fables; unknown whether they add up or overlap. Queued q36 | R54: q36 (additive 0.05) retired; re-queued with the v35 hybrid rule as q41 (x6/x8 + PE on text3000 / fables2000 / order3) and q40 (x4/x6 + PE on fables4000)
ideas.why: longer memory for non-repetitive text (Travis) without a second hand-tuned plan

ideas.title: Analogy needs symbol-independent role cells: after renaming, old symbol-specific weights interfere (negative transfer); test faster unlearning (predErr dose) first, then role/structure codes
ideas.evidence: R50 q31: every plan is far worse right after the renaming than a fresh brain (order3 0.59 vs 0.92), predErr 0.05 recovers part (0.72). Queued q37 (predErr 0.1/0.2 after renaming)
ideas.why: Travis: learn and think by analogy; a brain that only unlearns faster is still not transferring structure

ideas.title: Confidence-gated predErr: depress only when the cell's prediction is usually right (running hit rate or a population-confidence gate), so noisy 24-symbol fables streams are not eroded
ideas.evidence: R50: fables (accuracy 0.28, optimal 0.33) loses 0.63 at predErr 0.05 and already in the first quarter, while text (0.74) and order3 (0.86) gain; mismatches dominate when most predictions miss. Needs code in js/core/net.js (off by default); after q35 / p04 show the dose shape | R52/R53: solved differently: weight-dependent (soft-bound) LTD with a small fixed part keeps the weak fables weights; the confidence gate (peMode 8) helped less | R52 peMode 8 (scaled by 1 - own confirmation rate) only cut the fables loss from -0.62 to -0.44; the soft-bound / hybrid rule (I65, R53) removed it -> v35
ideas.why: keeps the world-model gain on text / order3 without the fables loss -> could make predErr adoptable

ideas.title: predErr fables fix: soft-bound (multiplicative) mismatch LTD, pl.peMode bitmask
ideas.evidence: R52, 32 paired growths: plain predErr 0.05 fables -0.62 (t -11.8) / text3000 +0.32; peMode 1 (dw ~ w/wMax) at predErr 1: text3000 +0.26/+0.24 (t 8.7/10.5), text1000 +0.19/+0.12, fables -0.05/-0.05 (t -2.6/-2.8), order3 gain lost (-0.01/+0.02). Renorm (2) halves the damage; one depression per prediction (4) helps fables (+0.11 at 0.2) but kills text gain; confidence-scaled (8) no better. Text gain and fables loss share one cause (additive LTD of weak weights) | R53: hybrid peMode 16 (dw = predErr*lr*x*(peFix + (1-peFix) w/wMax)), predErr 0.3, peFix 0.01, 32 paired growths: fables -0.007 (n.s.), text3000 +0.164 (t 11.7), order3 +0.085 (t 2.5), text1000 +0.086, text5000 +0.236 -> adopted as v35 (Oct 17, Travis approved). R54: renumbered from a duplicate I61; PC port bit-identical (text1000 g0 7.53)
ideas.why: world-model learning without silencing rare-symbol pathways

ideas.title: Long NON-repeating sequence benchmark: score long memory on fables 4000 (one full pass of the 4270-char corpus) and on a much bigger public-domain corpus (>= 50k chars), not on 'text' (a 224-char loop)
ideas.evidence: R54: text3000 / text5000 replay the 224-char text corpus 13-22 times, so the life-length growth of the v35 / depth gains on text is loop recall; on fables2000 (no repeat) v35 is neutral (-0.007) and depth loses (x8 -0.09). q40 + shared p14 measure fables4000 now; a bigger corpus needs code (new seq source)
ideas.why: Travis's focus is longer memory without short repetitive patterns; the current long-text metric rewards memorising a short loop

ideas.title: Long-life stability on real text: no prediction-miss LTD + capped metaplastic consolidation (pl.metaCap) + graded decoder (readIn)
ideas.evidence: R62: v35 declines with life length on book (0.29 at 3k -> 0.15 at 100k) because the potentiation scale metaN/(metaN+E) fades while LTD does not; an offline readout of the states reaches 0.40. readIn 0.01 + predErr 0 + metaCap 200, 16 held-out growths vs v35: book30k +0.084, book10k +0.046, fables4000 +0.030, fables2000 +0.028, order3 +0.049, text1000 +0.008, none worse -> v36 (Oct 17, Travis approved)
ideas.why: a learner that keeps learning over long lives

ideas.title: Space bias: v36 predicts space 62% of the time vs 20% truth; output-side fixes (stronger graded decoder, longer read window, weak homeostasis of taught cells) that must not hurt book30k
ideas.evidence: R62: rcvHomeo 0.2 book30k 0.15 (harm); queued w19-w21; R63 (16 growths, vs w13): readIn 0.03 = same, readIn 0.1 -0.008 (0/16), readTicks 6 / 8 -0.14 / -0.20, rcvHomeo 0.02 / 0.05 -0.19 / -0.18 (all rejected); output-side fixes do not work. Next: trust / sharpness weighting (x03, x07) and very weak homeostasis at a realistic target rate (x09); R64 (16 growths): rcvHomeo 0.005 at rcvRate 0.1 / 0.002 collapse book (0.12 / 0.10-0.13); trustPow 4 -0.06 book; confPow 2 -0.01; boundary precision stays 0.30-0.33 under every rule knob, only size raises it (4xS 0.32-0.36). Output-side / homeostatic fixes exhausted
ideas.why: part of the gap between v36 (0.31) and the 0.40 linear ceiling

ideas.title: Stable letter-pair (mixing) codes: 98k distinct codes for 410 pairs, so trigram conjunctions cannot be reused; slower mixing homeostasis, learned mixing, fewer claws
ideas.evidence: R62: mixing readout of the next letter 0.19-0.23; mixHomeo 0.05 order3 +0.012, book ~0 (16 growths); queued w22-w24; R63 (16 growths, book30k / fables4000 vs w13 / eval16c): mixHomeo 0.05 +0.001 / -0.002, 0.15 -0.000 / -0.001, mixLr 0.005 +0.003 (10/4, t 2.3) / -0.001, mixLr 0.02 +0.002 / -0.001, mixK 3 -0.000 / +0.001, mixK 5 +0.001 / -0.000: the mixing code knobs do not move the readout (only mixLr 0.005 is confirmed further, x13); R64 x13: mixLr 0.005 book10k +0.000, order3 +0.011, text1000 -0.027 (0/16): rejected
ideas.why: needed to go past bigram towards the 3-gram 0.43-0.52

ideas.title: Teacher-rule knobs of the taught (cortex) cells toward the 0.40 readout ceiling: trustPow, lr, metaCap, preNorm, confPow / trustMax, small predErr, plateau, preLag
ideas.evidence: R62: the readout, not the representation, is the bottleneck (oracle 0.40 vs brain 0.31); metaN 0 gave book 0.34 but order3 0.87. R63: queued as 5-task screens (book30k, book10k, fables4000, order3, text1000; 16 growths), x03-x11, so a winner is adoption-ready at once; R64 (5-task screens vs v36, 16 growths): lr 0.1 wins all 5 (book10k +0.009 16/0, book30k +0.011 16/0, fables4000 +0.010 16/0, order3 +0.011 13/2, text1000 +0.005 13/3) -> adopted in v37 (I79); metaCap 100 / 50, metaN 80, preNorm 60 win book + fables but lose order3 (-0.005..-0.023); plateau 6 mildly positive on all 5; trustPow 4 / 0, confPow 2, preLag 4 / 12, predErr 0.03 / 0.01, metaN 20, lr 0.025, preNorm 30, plateau 2 rejected; trustMax 8 identical. Next on v37: y02 (lr 0.15 / 0.2), y04 (plateau 6 / metaCap 100 / metaN 80), y07 (tauPre 8 / 18); R69 (y02 / y04 / y07 vs v37, 16 growths): cortex lr 0.2 book10k +0.008 (15/1), book30k +0.009 (15/1), fables +0.007 (16/0), order3 -0.007 (7/6, t -1.5), text +0.001 -> adoption candidate, fresh-seed confirmation y08a/b (+ lr 0.3 / 0.5 y09); lr 0.15 +0.005; metaCap 100 / metaN 80 win book / fables but lose order3 again (t -2.8 / -2.1); plateau 6 +0.002-0.003 (n.s. on book10k); tauPre 8 / 18 worse (rejected)
ideas.why: the largest known gap (0.31 -> 0.40) is in the learning rule

ideas.title: Size scaling needs wiring scaled to the grid: coneSpeed and axonLen are in grid steps, so sc.grid alone shrinks axons relative to the sheet
ideas.status: confirmed on book / fables; hurts order3 and seqchoice
ideas.evidence: R63 box diagnosis (book 1.5k, 1 growth): grid 60 3.33, 85 2.67, 100 2.27, 110 / 120 0 (silent outputs; why w06 / w15 / w16 were all 0 and w14 2x lost -0.02); scaled (85: coneSpeed 4 axonLen 57 -> 3.20; 120: coneSpeed 6 axonLen 80 -> 3.43). Queued x01 (4xS) and x02 (2xS) at book 10k / 30k, x16 / x17 at 100k, x14 generation; R64 (16 growths vs v36 1x): 4xS book10k 0.346 (+0.030, 15/1, t 5.9), book30k 0.349 (+0.036, 15/1, t 6.8); 2xS 0.337 / 0.337 (+0.021 / +0.024, 14/2 / 13/2). Size pays; cost ~17x (4xS) / ~2.5x (2xS) per growth. Next: y03 / y05 (v37 at 4xS / 2xS on all 5 tasks), x16 / x17 (size x 100k); R69: the gain is TEXT-ONLY. v37 4xS vs 1x (y03, 16 growths): book10k +0.020, book30k +0.022, fables +0.017, but order3 -0.238 (0/16), text1000 +0.002; 2xS (y05): order3 -0.154, text1000 -0.017; 4xS seqchoice collapses (z10 vs z08, same seeds: order2 1.84 vs 6.20, cycle 1.43 vs 9.13, 0/8); v37 4xS = v36 4xS on book (rule and size gains do not add); length flat at 2xS / 4xS (100k = 30k). See I87
ideas.why: every earlier 'size does not pay' result is confounded; this decides the large-brain run

ideas.title: v37: faster cortex teacher rule (lr 0.1) + striatum prediction-miss LTD back (predErr 0.3, as v35)
ideas.evidence: R64: cortex lr 0.1 vs v36, 16 held-out growths: book10k +0.009 (16/0), book30k +0.011 (16/0), fables4000 +0.010 (16/0), order3 +0.011 (13/2), text1000 +0.005 (13/3); no effect on seqchoice. x12 + box: the v36 seqchoice order2 loss (-0.035, t -2.45, 32 growths) is the striatum missing predErr; v36 + striatum predErr 0.3 = v35 exactly on seqchoice and bit-identical to v36 on seq tasks (no striatum without an outcome). Adopted as v37 / DEFAULTS_VERSION 30 under Travis's standing authorisation (no task worse)
ideas.why: the only rule knob that wins every task; restores reward-coupled sequence learning

ideas.title: Growth that scales past 4x: proliferation / growth time counted in developmental steps (like coneSpeed / axonLen before R63)
ideas.evidence: R64 box (1 growth): 8xS (grid 170, maxCells 27200, coneSpeed 8, axonLen 113) grows 15.2k cells, book 1.5k 2.04 / 5k 1.98 vs 4xS 3.62 / 3.80; branchMax 1000 or maxCells 40000: no change; pDiv 1: 22k cells, 3.38 / 3.55 and 3.06 (still < 4xS). Needs a code-level fix (scale division rate / developmental time with the grid) before any 8x run
ideas.why: the large-brain run needs brains beyond 4x

ideas.title: Output confidence gate: readout fires only when winner share / margin passes pl.outGate; learning continues regardless
ideas.evidence: R65 box 1x book30k (4 growths): share>=0.5 fires on 34% with precision 0.525 vs 0.339; generation gate 0.5 gives word 0.63 / distinct4 0.51 vs greedy 0.75 / 0.013 (loops) and T1 0.52 / 0.69; R69 (z06 16 growths 1x, z07 8 growths 4xS): teacher-forced accuracy unchanged; 4xS share 0.5 coverage 0.376 precision 0.512; generation word rate greedy 0.56 / T1 0.54 / gate 0.5 0.63 / margin 0.2 0.70 / gate 0.4 + T0.7 0.74, distinct4 0.013 / 0.66 / 0.35 / 0.29 / 0.17, trigram bits 5.26 / 6.14 / 5.69 / 5.55 / 5.24 (real 2.57): a better generation policy than greedy or T1, not a learning gain. Travis's passive-then-active hunch: the output half is this gate; the confidence-gated learning half and a silent-then-acting seqchoice phase are not built yet (code)
ideas.why: stops greedy loops without pure noise; a step toward abstaining / self-paced generation

ideas.title: Staged maturation: latest-born cells stay silent and mature in waves during life (pl.stageF0 / stageWaves / stageTicks)
ideas.evidence: R65 box (1 growth): 1x book3000 2.97 vs 3.33 scratch; 4xS book10k 3.26 vs 3.405, life 6% faster. Masking only, so the full brain is still allocated; R69 z04 (4xS book30k, 16 growths vs y03 scratch): staged A -0.004 (3/11, t -3.7), B -0.001 (6/8); z05 wall 795 vs 817 s per growth (3%)
ideas.why: juvenile-small then large could save time and give better early learning

ideas.title: Engine speed / memory: bit-identical fast paths in net.js, dropDense after build
ideas.evidence: R65: life 1.47x (1x) / 1.59x (4xS), total 1.40x / 1.43x on book10k; 36/36 + 2/2 + verify 15/15 fingerprints identical; 4xS life RSS 1.45 -> 0.26 GB
ideas.why: 4xS cost 17x on workers; faster turnaround for the scale track

ideas.title: Fast engine (params.fastEngine 1): scaled shared-factor traces, hot-set teacher, lean membrane loop; not bit-identical, judged by scores
ideas.evidence: R66 box: life 1.86x (1x) / 1.60x (4xS) vs exact, total 1.70x / 1.45x; screen of 8 growths x 6 tasks no task worse (seqchoice order2 -0.028 t -0.89); 4xS peak RSS 1.59 -> 1.08 GB; R69: z10 (4xS fables / order3 / text / seqchoice, 8 growths) no task worse (order3 / text identical, fables +0.0003, seqchoice -0.015 / -0.036 fit, t -0.8 / -0.9); with z08 (1x 16 x 7 tasks) and z09 (4xS book10k 16/16 identical) -> fastEngine 1 is the default in v38 (DEFAULTS_VERSION 31); worker book10k 35 vs 70 s (1x), 260 vs 368 s (4xS); z10b completes 4xS to 16 growths
ideas.why: 4xS cost 17x on workers; the scale track needs faster lives

ideas.title: Sparser activity: adaptive hidden thresholds (hidHomeo), pooled region inhibition (regInh, k-WTA style), thrAdd, regMask
ideas.evidence: R67 box: text tasks already 1.6-2% cortex spiking per substep; best candidate (cortex hidHomeo 0.002 / 0.05) book10k -0.114 0/8, book30k -0.122, fables -0.074 for -25% activity; 10x fewer spikes -> 1.05x (1x) / 1.43x (4xS) speed, event mode slower
ideas.why: Hoped sparser cortex-like activity would speed the engine and keep accuracy

ideas.title: Fewer substeps per symbol: P.substeps 3 / 2, task on/hold/read 3 / 2, life-only lifeSub, dtRescale (time constants rescaled to a coarser dt)
ideas.evidence: R68 box, 8 paired growths: substeps 3 -0.02 to -0.07 (0-1 wins of 8 on every task), task timing 3 -0.01 to -0.05, 2 substeps or 2-tick timing -0.05 to -0.67; dtRescale -0.05 to -0.97; life speed 1.13-1.39x (1x), 0.93-1.19x (4xS)
ideas.why: Run time tracks cells x substeps; hoped the dynamics survive a coarser step

ideas.title: Why scaled brains lose order3 / seqchoice: bigger cortex or (non-plastic) context regions dilute sharp sequence context; plan-wide sc.* variants also inflate the 400-cell striatum
ideas.evidence: R69 box (order3 growths 0-1, 1x 9.68 / 9.65): 4xS all 7.28 / 7.28, cortex only 7.75 / 8.13, context only 7.60 / 7.75, context 2xS 8.13 / 8.15, context grid 120 with 1x wiring 7.60 / 7.75, maxCells alone or wiring alone at grid 60 = 1x; seqchoice cycle / order2 all 4xS 2.04 / 0.01, 2.48 / 1.53, striatum kept 3.27 / 6.37, 3.31 / 2.52. Queued y10a/b (4xS by region, 16 growths, 6 tasks), y16 (2xS by region), y17 (long fables x size), y21 (3xS)
ideas.why: a large brain that loses higher-order context cannot become a language model; the size track depends on fixing this
